evidence: Events.js:15 - off() removes a listener by hand; nothing unsubscribes when an object is collected. No WeakRef or FinalizationRegistry exists (grep of core/Events found none). Easy to do: a WeakRef per listener target plus a FinalizationRegistry, but it is not built.

Events.js:9 - "(this._on ??= {})[event] ??= [];" creates listener storage only on the first on(), so that part is built. Missing: off() (Events.js:15) leaves an empty array per event name, and emit() (Events.js:24) copies every listener list with slice() on each call.
public/framework/core/Events/Events.js:9 - "(this._on ??= {})[event] ??= [];" creates the listener map on demand, only when it does not exist yet.
